title: THE EVERSTAR MMORPG SMP
description: The Everstar MMORPG SMP is a cross-platform, extremely ambitious project in open beta. Also, no mods are needed either, for Bedrock OR Java!
body:
# 🌟 THE EVERSTAR MMORPG SMP 🌟

**The Everstar MMORPG SMP is an extremely ambitious upcoming dark fantasy/dieselpunk server in open beta right now. Inspired by the Dark Soul & Zelda franchises gameplay-wise, and Berserk & Lord Of The Rings lore-wise, the Land of Everstar is filled with hundreds of secrets, a massive world map, custom mobs, gear, insane builds, and even more, Everstar will no doubt leave a mark on the online Minecraft community. Below is just a small list of what's in the server:**

- 🗺️ 15k x 15k surface world
- 🦇 7k x 7k subterranean world (Nether replacement)
- 🏠 Private player platforms
- 🧟 Custom models
- 🧌 Custom bosses
- 🦌 Custom mobs
- ⚔️ Custom gear
- 🪑 Custom furniture
- ⛓️ Player-instance dungeons
- 🪨🖥️ Bedrock + Java crossplay
- 🌳 Completely custom RPG plugins (Skilltrees, crates, innate abilities, etc.)
- 🌆 Huge cities
- 🏙️ Detailed villages
- 📖 An ebook
- 📚 Insane amounts of lore, with players having the chance to be written into the canon lore
- 🧾 Weekly newspaper
- ☠️ Intense interactive live events
- 💻 Constant development - New additions every week
- 💰 Donator quality-of-life perks
- 🧚 Cosmetics

**And so much more, so what're you waiting for? Join now and leave a permanent mark on the server.**


**_(It is highly recommended to join the Discord since the server is barren at the moment, but still has hours of gameplay hidden throughout. The folks on the server can help you locate secret dungeons and such.)_**
